Ottawa sharpens innovation and trade priorities with new AI leadership. 🌐

### Sovereign Tech & Artificial Intelligence
Prime Minister Carney established the National Council on Artificial Intelligence to execute the federal "AI for All" strategy, accelerating domestic public sector adoption. The technological roadmap mandates Canadian-resident sovereign AI compute stacks, national foundation model safety benchmarking, and enterprise data governance frameworks. Advisory practices should align federal departments and Crown corporations with sovereign AI compliance, domestic data residency verification, and secure model implementation.

### Global Trade & Industrial Supply Chains
Global Affairs Canada expanded trade diversification initiatives at the G20 Trade Ministers' Meeting in Milwaukee, engaging Saudi Arabia, the European Union, and India to counter supply chain vulnerabilities and steel excess capacity. Operationalization centers on deploying digital trade corridors, critical minerals traceability systems, and steel production verification protocols. Export advisory and supply chain consultancies can structure compliance roadmaps for domestic industrial and clean-technology firms entering these bilateral corridors.

### Clean Energy & Infrastructure
Environment and Climate Change Canada and the Federation of Canadian Municipalities allocated $66.3 million through the Green Municipal Fund across 162 municipal and affordable housing initiatives. Capital deployment specifies cold-climate heat pumps, ENERGY STAR building envelope retrofits, high-efficiency fenestration, and municipal financing administration software. Engineering firms should target subcontracting mandates across measurement and verification, building energy audits, and turn-key retrofit project management.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/
#ArtificialIntelligence #GlobalTrade #CleanTech #Infrastructure #PublicProcurement
